source_format: Official DOCX converted locally to native searchable PDF
edition_distinction: The official Word original uses Times New Roman and local pagination is 14 pages. The association scan is a separate Arial edition with 16 pages; its layout is not claimed to match this Korean edition.

fonts.latin: Times New Roman matching official Word body
fonts.hangul: Noto Serif KR matching serif body; Malgun Gothic matching original sans-serif diagram labels

omission_background: Associated introductory paragraph on use of the explosive material is also omitted.

editorial_notes.change: HCl and H2O are each 10% of the initial mass, as explicitly stated in official solution w(HCl)=w(H2O)=0.1. Corrected an earlier draft that incorrectly said their combined loss was 10%.
Restored the photon nu in Br2/hν that was blank in LibreOffice output; checked against the official DOCX and association scan.

The official Word file contains eight planet choices and Symbol F0FF marks. Its undefined marks render blank; these are normalized to empty square checkboxes at the original mark origins. The association scan omits the choices entirely.
Original acetoacetone is translated as acetylacetone based on the depicted reactant and reaction; correction explicitly identified in the body.
The first ammonium reference is translated as the free amine, matching the same question’s explicit R3N; correction explicitly identified in the body.
Stability constant 10^(8.5) is rendered with the complete decimal exponent 8.5 raised, retaining its numeric meaning.

The original question asks for logarithm differences without specifying a base. Korean does not impose base10; official solution ln difference11.29 and equivalent base10 difference4.90 are distinguished in the solution editorial notes.

diagram_checks: Tebbe and Raney labels, sclareoloxide, S-(+)-carvone, Li excess, concentrated acid, two dichlorobenzene solvent labels, pyridine and all 110°C/120°C values checked.
Original reaction arrows, structural formulas, reagent identifiers and every numeric table cell kept.
Kapustinsky fraction, Stern–Volmer fraction, redox half-reactions, native extraction equation and chromate equilibria retained.
Intracellular hydrolase labels, mass-spectral vertical axis, NMR headings and multiplicities translated while original masses, integrals and chemical shifts are retained.
Automatic question numbers on wrapped paragraphs remain at their native source positions.
source_mass_condition_review: Inorganic 3 original 4.45 g precipitate, 0.45 g H2O loss and 4.40 g final precipitate are consistent with O2 uptake on Mn(II) to Mn(III) oxidation. All original values are retained with no claim of an arithmetic error.

numeric_source_solution_review.manual_numeric_difference_review: All numeric differences in t2_numeric_comparison_draft.json reviewed: scientific notation / superscript extraction, a Word artifact preceding inorganic 1.1, half-reaction and extraction-equation values retained natively, and C2H5OH translated as ethanol. Physical 1.2 condition cross-checked against the official solution.
